EmailTemplate.name: Workgroup Empty Or Inactive Membership Notification
EmailTemplate.Body:
Hello Team,

The ownership validation completed on $reportDate.
Summary: $workgroupCount workgroups, $bundleCount bundles, and $entitlementCount entitlements require review.

Admin workgroup: $adminWorkgroupName

1) Workgroups with no members or no active members

#if($workgroupFindings && $workgroupFindings.size() > 0) #foreach($wg in $workgroupFindings) #end #else #end
Workgroup Name Display Name Issue Type Total Members Active Members Owner Group Email
$wg.workgroupName $wg.displayName $wg.issueType $wg.totalMembers $wg.activeMembers $wg.owner $wg.groupEmail
No workgroups found with issues.

2) Bundles with inactive/missing owner

#if($bundleFindings && $bundleFindings.size() > 0) #foreach($b in $bundleFindings) #end #else #end
Bundle Name Display Name Owner Type Owner Name Issue Type
$b.bundleName $b.displayName $b.ownerType $b.ownerName $b.issueType
No bundles found with inactive/missing owner.

3) Entitlements with inactive/missing owner

#if($entitlementFindings && $entitlementFindings.size() > 0) #foreach($e in $entitlementFindings) #end #else #end
Application Attribute Value Display Name Owner Type Owner Name Issue Type
$e.applicationName $e.attribute $e.value $e.displayName $e.ownerType $e.ownerName $e.issueType
No entitlements found with inactive/missing owner.

Regards,
IdentityIQ
EmailTemplate.Description: Email notification listing workgroup, bundle, and entitlement owner/membership issues.
EmailTemplate.Subject: Owner validation summary - WG:$workgroupCount Bundle:$bundleCount Ent:$entitlementCount
